The Floor is Lava! 🌋 You have 10 seconds to get both feet off the floor. 10, 9, 8...
Animal Walk Race! 🦀 Have a race with your parents but you can only walk sideways like a crab!
Freeze Dance! 🕺 Ask your parents to play your favorite Bollywood song. When they pause it, you must freeze like a statue!
The Wobbly Waiter! 🍽️ Put a plastic cup or small book on your head and try to walk from the bedroom to the kitchen without dropping it.
Jumping Jack Challenge! 🤸 How many jumping jacks can you do while singing the ABCs or a Kannada rhyme?
Balloon Keep-Up! 🎈 Blow up a balloon and see how long you and your parent can keep it from touching the ground.
Pillow Stepping Stones! ☁️ Place pillows on the floor and jump from one to the next to cross the 'crocodile river'.
Frog Jumps! 🐸 Do 10 giant frog jumps across the living room, ribbiting as loud as you can!
The Couch Obstacle Course! 🛋️ Climb over the couch, crawl under the dining table, and touch the front door as fast as you can.
Penguin Waddle! 🐧 Put a small pillow or soft ball between your knees and try to walk across the room without dropping it.
Mirror, Mirror! 🪞 Stand facing your parent. You must copy every funny move and silly face they make!
Indoor Bowling! 🎳 Set up empty plastic water bottles and roll a soft pair of socks or soft ball to knock them down.
The Tiptoe Ninja! 🥷 Can you walk through the whole house on your tiptoes without making a single sound?
Sticky Spider Web! 🕸️ Use some paper tape in a doorway and try to throw rolled-up newspaper 'flies' through it!
Wheelbarrow Walk! 🛒 Have your parent hold your ankles while you walk on your hands across the room.
Bear Crawl Safari! 🐻 Crawl on your hands and feet (not your knees!) around the house looking for hidden toys.
Book Balancing Act! 📚 Put a notebook on your head and see if you can sit down and stand back up without dropping it.
The Laundry Basket Toss! 🧺 Roll up 5 pairs of socks and see how many you can throw into the laundry basket from far away.
Helicopter Spins! 🚁 Spin around with your arms out 5 times, then try to walk in a straight line!
Yoga Tree Pose Challenge! 🌳 Stand on one leg and put your hands together. Who can balance the longest without falling?
